description: This file declares classes related to event threading, including an EventThread class implementing IEventThread and a factory class EventThreadFactory, within the firebolt::rialto::common namespace. It defines methods for creating, managing, and executing event threads, and includes necessary synchronization primitives.

classes.name: EventThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating EventThread instances, implementing IEventThreadFactory.

classes.name: EventThread
classes.description: Implementation of an event handling thread, managing a queue of functions to execute asynchronously.

methods.name: createEventThread
methods.description: Creates and returns a new IEventThread instance with the specified thread name.

methods.name: EventThread
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event thread with an optional thread name.

methods.name: ~EventThread
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the event thread.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the event queue, ensuring all queued functions are executed.

methods.name: addImpl
methods.description: Adds a new function to the event thread's queue for execution.

methods.name: threadExecutor
methods.description: Internal method running in the thread to execute queued functions.
